name: spring-fest
comments: Dev convenience only. This used to be the Firebase App Hosting entry point
for the whole repo — its buildpack ran npm install -> build -> start, where
build compiled the Vite SPA and start ran backend/server.js, which served
both. That is gone: the repo now deploys as TWO App Hosting backends, each
with its own root directory and apphosting.yaml — `web` (Next.js) and
`backend` (the Express API). Neither reads this file.
The old `dependencies` block mirrored backend/package.json so the runtime
image had them; backend/ is its own deploy root now and carries its own.
